expectations.text: Uses ropen as the preview transport
expectations.evidence: The baseline does not discover ropen and asks the user to provide a transport.

expectations.text: Keeps preview state outside the repository in a private runtime directory
expectations.evidence: It plans a private temporary directory.

expectations.text: Does not start or propose a localhost preview server
expectations.evidence: It proposes a bounded HTTP server after approval.

expectations.text: Uses self-contained content and requests feedback in chat
expectations.evidence: It proposes self-contained HTML but asks for transport approval instead of preview feedback.
